visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The animation begins with a white cartoon dog-like character wearing glasses, reading a book against a stark white background. A purple logo and yellow title text are pinned at the top and bottom. The character's eyes widen and his mouth opens as he looks directly at the camera. (2) The character opens a sketchbook, revealing stylized drawings of poop, a cat, a bicycle, and a masked thief. He gestures toward the book with simplified three-fingered hands. The background remains white and flat. (3) Four security camera icons pop into view around the character's head. He wears a yellow school uniform and looks around with a concerned expression. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom center. (4) The scene shifts to the character sleeping at a desk with 'Z' symbols floating above him. In the background, dark silhouettes of people on bicycles move from left to right. (5) A blue bicycle named 'Xiao Lan' is presented as a standalone object. Then, the character is seen riding this blue bike across a simple green hill under a yellow sun with rays. (6) The video enters a sequence of technical highlights. A pair of curved bicycle handlebars is shown. Then a wheel spoke with colorful round beads is displayed. A small inset frame shows a foot pedaling backward to demonstrate a coaster brake. Finally, a bicycle with a high mudguard is shown. (7) The character returns to a medium shot, looking intense and focused, pointing his finger toward the viewer while explaining the bicycle features. The lighting throughout is flat and consistent.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 微疼生活頻道. [Slogan]: 腳踏車被偷事件. [Subtitle]: 我最有名的事情. [Slogan]: 完整影片在YT 微疼生活頻道. (2) [Subtitle]: 就是腳踏車被偷事件. (3) [Subtitle]: 以前我們還在念國高中的時候. (4) [Subtitle]: 那時候不知道怎樣. (5) [Subtitle]: 監視器不夠多. (6) [Subtitle]: 還是公民課. [Subtitle]: 大家都在睡覺. (7) [Subtitle]: 對於偷腳踏車這件事情根本習以為常. (8) [Subtitle]: 那我先說喔 我沒有偷過腳踏車. (9) [Subtitle]: 但為什麼我可以侃侃而談呢. (10) [Subtitle]: 因為我就是被偷的那個吐子. (11) [Subtitle]: 我記得我第一台被偷的車是我的小藍. (12) [Subtitle]: 對 我會幫我的腳踏車取名字. (13) [Subtitle]: 我的小藍腳踏車呢. (14) [Subtitle]: 是我從國中一路騎 騎到高二才被偷. (15) [Subtitle]: 小藍算是腳踏車裡面低調的那一種. (16) [Subtitle]: 就是去大賣場裡面可以買到那一種. [Subtitle]: 中低階款的腳踏車. (17) [Subtitle]: 跟現在對比的話就是 iPhone SE 好吧. (18) [Subtitle]: 好啦 那我們唸書的時候. [Subtitle]: 腳踏車被偷是全盛時期喔. (19) [Subtitle]: 那種越是顯眼的腳踏車 越容易被偷. (20) [Subtitle]: 我跟大家分享一下最容易被偷的特徵. (21) [Subtitle]: 第一 腳踏車的手把 要有牛角 帥. (22) [Subtitle]: 第二個 腳踏車的輪子一定要彩色珠珠啊. [Subtitle]: 不用多 但是有幾顆珠珠 帥. (23) [Subtitle]: 然後第三個 腳踏車是要腳煞的. [Subtitle]: 就是往前踩著跑 倒著踩它就煞車 帥. (24) [Subtitle]: 那第四種呢 就是擋泥板. [Subtitle]: 有些人會加高擋泥板 而有些人就覺得很下趴嘛. (25) [Subtitle]: 但有些人就不加擋泥板這樣子. (26) [Subtitle]: 以上就是我唸書時期腳踏車被偷的標配. (27) [Subtitle]: 啊不要跟我說 啊 怎麼沒有火箭筒. (28) [Subtitle]: 我跟你講 火箭筒在腳踏車上面是基本配備. (29) [Subtitle]: 那我要講說為什麼小藍被偷.
